title: This Study is the Clinical Validation Study for Validation for the Digital Pathology System 'SGi 1.0 + EPW 1.0 + Compatible Clinical Displays'
official: Clinical Study Protocol SGi 1.0 + EPW 1.0 + Compatible Clinical Displays Clinical Validation Study
summary: The primary objective of this study is to show safety and effectiveness of the investigational device for In Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) use as an aid to the pathologist to view, review and diagnose digital images of surgical pathology slides.
